en.title: ETSI TS 119 472-2: the ban on unsigned requests names a value OpenID4VP does not define
en.summary: OIDFVP-HAIP-API-03 bars the exchange protocol value "openid4vp-1-unsigned". OpenID4VP 1.0 defines "openid4vp-v1-unsigned". The value in the ban is not one that OpenID4VP defines, so the ban does not name the value in use. The text is the same in V1.2.1 and V1.3.1.
en.impact: A wallet that refuses "openid4vp-1-unsigned" and accepts "openid4vp-v1-unsigned" meets the letter of the requirement, while unsigned requests still go through.
en.correction: Use "openid4vp-v1-unsigned" in API-03. If unsigned requests are meant to be permitted, remove API-03 and align the requirements on signed requests.
